speaker: Isadora
cn: 你怎么知道我的指围的？
en: How do you know my size?

speaker: Isadora
cn: （挑眉）惯犯啊！这么熟练。
en: (Arising an eyebrow) You’ve done this before, haven’t you? You’re awfully smooth.

speaker: Damián
cn: 怎么可能！我的恋爱经历你还不知道吗？
en: How is that possible! Don't you even know about my dating history?

speaker: Isadora
cn: 也是，你没什么能瞒得过我的。
en: Yeah, you can't hide anything from me.

speaker: Isadora(VO)
cn: 要不要把我才是总裁的事情告诉他？
en: Should I tell him that I’m actually the CEO?

speaker: Isadora
cn: Damián，其实……
en: Damián, actually……

speaker: Samanta
cn: （无语）吃饭了，别在这秀恩爱了。
en: (Stunned) Dinner’s ready. Enough with the lovey-dovey stuff.

speaker: Damián
cn: （皱眉看Isadora）你想说什么？
en: (frowning at Isadora) What did you want to say?

speaker: Isadora
cn: 下次再跟你说吧。
en: I'll tell you next time.

speaker: Beatriz
cn: （笑）Isadora性格冷，坚强，我也没想到能找到Damián你这样开朗的孩子。
en: (laughs) Isadora’s always been reserved and strong. I never thought she’d end up with someone as cheerful as you, Damián.

speaker: Beatriz
cn: 这是我给你准备的礼物。
en: This is the gift I've got you.

speaker: Samanta
cn: （惊）妈！这不是我一直想要的那辆全球限量的跑车吗！
en: (startled) Mom! Isn’t this the limited-edition supercar I’ve always wanted?

speaker: Beatriz
cn: 你的车都有那么多了，也不差这一辆。
en: You already have so many cars. You don't need another one.

speaker: Isadora
cn: 妈给你的，你就拿着吧。不用管Samanta，这也就是她两个月的零花钱而已。
en: Mom gave it to you, so just take it. Ignore Samanta. It’s only two months’ worth of her allowance anyway.

speaker: Damián
cn: （咋舌）不愧是贵族家庭，两个月零花钱就能买下一辆限量跑车。
en: (In awe) Now that’s an old-money family. Two months’ allowance is enough to buy a limited-edition supercar!

speaker: Samanta（VO）
cn: 这戒指是今年新款，我记得要好几百万美元，就连他送我的项链也要几十万美元，这小子不会把全部身家都拿出来了吧？难道我真的误会他了？
en: That ring is from this year’s latest collection. I remember it costs several million dollars. Even the necklace he gave me is worth hundreds of thousands. Did this guy really spend everything he has on us? Have I been wrong about him this whole time?

speaker: Samanta
cn: 这是我们Elorza家族的卡，是实名制的，你出去在我们家族的产业下购物吃饭，都不用花钱。之前误会你了，抱歉。
en: This is an Elorza family card, registered in your name. You can shop or dine at any of our family’s businesses for free. I misjudged you before. I’m sorry.

speaker: Damián
cn: 这是给我的？
en: This is for me？

speaker: Samanta
cn: （皱眉）不要算了。
en: (frowning) Take it or leave it.

speaker: Isadora
cn: （劝）接着吧，好东西。
en: (encouraging) Take it. It's really handy.

speaker: Damián
cn: （笑）那就谢谢妈和Samanta了。我一定会好好对待Isadora的。
en: (laughs) I appreciate it, Mom and Samanta. I will definitely treat Isadora well.

speaker: Beatriz
cn: Damián明晚九点有个珠宝鉴赏的宴会，到时候Isadora的爷爷也会去。你记得准备一下，给他留个好印象。
en: Damián, there’s a jewelry gala tomorrow night at nine. Isadora’s grandfather will be there too. Make sure you’re prepared. You’ll want to make a good impression on him.

speaker: Damián（VO）
cn: （思考）参加完同学聚会，再去晚宴应该来得及。
en: I should still be able to make it to the gala after the reunion.

speaker: Damián
cn: （点头）好的妈，我知道了。
en: (nodding) Sure Mom. I understand.
